# AuraTV

> AuraTV is a free live sport and TV guide for Algeria. It lists today's football fixtures with the channel showing each one, and provides a web player for beIN Sports, Algerian, French and Arabic channels. No account is required. AuraTV does not host video; streams are relayed from third-party sources and removed on request.

Site: https://auratvdz.lovable.app
Languages: English, French, Arabic (switchable in the header)
Timezone used for fixtures: Africa/Algiers

## Main pages

- [Home: today's fixtures and channel guide](https://auratvdz.lovable.app/)
- [Live now: matches currently in play](https://auratvdz.lovable.app/live)
- [Channel status: automated uptime checks](https://auratvdz.lovable.app/status)
- [Android app download](https://auratvdz.lovable.app/download)
- [My channels: add your own streams, stored on your device](https://auratvdz.lovable.app/settings/channels)

## Notes for agents

- Fixture times are shown in Algeria time (UTC+1).
- The channel guide is grouped by category (beIN Sports MAX, Algeria TV, French TV, MBC, and so on).
- Do not link to /api/ or /admin; these are not public content.
